chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I raced. First Send the Runner for free, exhausting a spare Coral Guard I had no plan to play, on the chance the draw is another free attack. Then both copies of Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense at Nibbit for 6 each. Then my two energy went to All Streams Flow to the Sea (9 printed, +4 from 8 Charge at one per two = 13) and Water's Edge for 6. That is 31 damage into a 34 HP enemy, leaving Nibbit at 3. Finally Shinobu — Grass Ring of Sanctification, free, for 4 Block, so the telegraphed 12 lands as 8 and I end at 40/70. I checked lethal first and it is not there: the most damage the hand can buy is 31, and Pearl Barrage swapped in for Water's Edge (5 plus whatever a single 1-cost exhaust adds) does not close a 3-point gap under any plausible scale rate, so I optimised for leaving Nibbit at a number that any single card kills next turn.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: Yes — the full turtle. Shinobu for 4 plus two Coral Guards for 10 is 14 Block against a 12 attack, taking zero, with both Gorou still free for 12 damage, leaving Nibbit at 22. I rejected it on the arithmetic of turns rather than of this turn: 22 is a two-turn kill, so I would eat something like another 12–24 across the extra rounds to save the 8 I take now. I also weighed the half-measure — All Streams plus one Coral Guard, enemy at 9, only 3 damage taken — and rejected it for the same reason. 3 is a one-card kill next turn; 9 is not. And I considered Pearl Barrage over Water's Edge for the second energy, dropping it because the printed scale rate is unstated and 6 guaranteed beats an unknown that cannot reach lethal anyway.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: 8 HP off a pool already down to 48, and both Coral Guards left unplayed with a third exhausted to Send the Runner — the whole defensive half of the hand spent as nothing. It also burns both Gorou copies and All Streams in one turn, so if Nibbit survives at 3 through some effect I did not price, next turn opens with a much thinner hand. The Shinobu block is a consolation, not a plan.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. The 12 is small enough that eating it is cheap, which is what makes the race correct. Telegraph a hit around 20 or more and I flip to Shinobu plus two Coral Guards for 14 Block with the two free Gorou on top — at that damage the HP is worth more than the tempo. A defend or buff intent would also change it, but the other way: with nothing incoming I would still play the same four attacks and simply skip Shinobu. And if Nibbit's HP were 31 or lower against this same intent the line stops being a race and becomes lethal, which needs no deliberation at all.
